mapper.sql: FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id = b.community_id JOIN layout_template lt ON lt.layout_template_id = pu.layout_template_id

WHERE 1 = 1 AND c.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0 AND c.community_id = #{query.communityId} AND b.building_id = #{query.buildingId} AND lt.layout_type = #{query.layoutType} AND pu.occupancy_status = #{query.occupancyStatus} AND (pu.property_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR c.community_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR b.building_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR b.building_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR CONCAT(b.building_no, '号楼') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR bu.unit_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR bu.unit_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select: SELECT pu.property_unit_id, pu.property_no, c.community_name, CONCAT(b.building_no, '号楼') AS building_name, COALESCE(bu.unit_name, CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元')) AS unit_name, lt.layout_type, pu.gross_area, pu.occupancy_status ORDER BY c.community_code, b.building_no, bu.unit_no, pu.property_no LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT pu.property_unit_id, pu.property_no, c.community_name, CONCAT(b.building_no, '号楼') AS building_name, COALESCE(bu.unit_name, CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元')) AS unit_name, lt.layout_type, pu.gross_area, pu.usable_area, pu.property_use, pu.occupancy_status, pu.status WHERE pu.property_unit_id = #{propertyUnitId}

SELECT p.full_name, p.phone, CONCAT('产权份额 ', ROUND(o.ownership_share * 100, 2), '%') AS relationship_role FROM ownership o JOIN person p ON p.person_id = o.person_id WHERE o.property_unit_id = #{propertyUnitId} AND o.end_date IS NULL ORDER BY o.start_date DESC, o.ownership_id DESC

SELECT p.full_name, CASE WHEN p.phone IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(p.phone) <= 7 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(p.phone, 2), '***') ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(p.phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(p.phone, 4)) END AS phone, CASE WHEN r.residence_role = 'RESPONSIBLE' AND pu.occupancy_status = 'OWNER_OCCUPIED' THEN '户主' WHEN r.residence_role = 'RESPONSIBLE' AND pu.occupancy_status = 'TENANT_OCCUPIED' THEN '主租户' WHEN r.relation_to_responsible = 'SPOUSE' THEN '配偶' WHEN r.relation_to_responsible = 'PARENT' THEN '父母' WHEN r.relation_to_responsible = 'CHILD' THEN '子女' WHEN r.relation_to_responsible = 'SIBLING' THEN '兄弟姐妹' WHEN r.relation_to_responsible = 'ROOMMATE' THEN '合租人' ELSE '其他' END AS relationship_role FROM residence r JOIN person p ON p.person_id = r.person_id JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = r.property_unit_id WHERE r.property_unit_id = #{propertyUnitId} AND r.end_date IS NULL ORDER BY CASE r.residence_role WHEN 'RESPONSIBLE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.start_date DESC

SELECT ft.fee_name, m.meter_no, m.status, m.initial_reading, m.installed_at FROM meter m JOIN fee_type ft ON ft.fee_type_id = m.fee_type_id WHERE m.property_unit_id = #{propertyUnitId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ft.fee_type_id
